description:
Returns the result of a parse job started by parse_invoice: structured fields (supplier, invoice number, dates, net/VAT/gross, currency, line items) plus export links for accounting systems.

Use when: you already have a job_id and want its status or its extracted data.
Do not use when: you have no job_id yet — start with parse_invoice. Do not poll in a tight loop: one call every few seconds is enough, text PDFs and XML usually finish in under a minute.

Side effects and cost: none. Does not touch the prepaid balance, so repeated polling is free; a failed job stays failed.

Parameter interactions and edge cases: job_id belongs to the key that created it, so a job started with one key is invisible to another. A pasted URL or a document id from another system returns 404 rather than a guess. A job that failed stays failed — polling it again will not resurrect it; start a new parse_invoice call instead.

Returns: {ok, result}, where result.status is queued, processing, done or failed; on done it also carries fields and export links.

api_key.description: DueBuddy API key (starts with dd_). Omit it when the server was added with an X-Api-Key header or DUEBUDDY_API_KEY is set. Must be the same key that started the job.
api_key.title: Api Key

job_id.description: Job identifier from the parse_invoice response, for example "2507". Scoped to the API key that created it: another key gets 404. Accepts the numeric id, not a URL.
job_id.title: Job Id

name: get_result
title: Get parsed invoice result
